title.hi: राज्य या केंद्रशासित प्रदेश की राजधानी

note.en: Every state's fifty biggest towns, a bead the size of a pinhead each, its area carrying the population. The thirty largest have their own cards; the rest come from GeoNames, checked against Wikidata, with figures that are mostly the 2011 census's. A town is its municipal limits, not its conurbation, which is why Delhi is smaller here than the city you have been to.
note.hi: हर राज्य के पचास सबसे बड़े नगर, हर एक पिन-सिरे जितना मनका, जिसका क्षेत्रफल जनसंख्या दर्शाता है। तीस सबसे बड़ों के अपने कार्ड हैं; बाक़ी जियोनेम्स से, विकिडेटा से जाँचे हुए, आँकड़े अधिकतर 2011 की जनगणना के। नगर उसकी निगम-सीमा है, नगरपुंज नहीं — इसीलिए दिल्ली यहाँ उस शहर से छोटी है जो आपने देखा है।

attribution: The thirty largest municipal corporations at the 2011 census are curated by hand; every state's fifty biggest towns are generated from GeoNames cities5000, placed by the ID raster, and kept only when Wikidata has the town with a Hindi name and confirms it is a town rather than a district filed under one.
_source: top_per_region and min_population are the generator's knobs; a curated item with the same name in the same state replaces the generated row. The engine reads marker and size, never this layer's name.
